title: Halloumi chickpea pepper tray
summary: Halloumi chickpea pepper tray is a mediterranean dinner built around halloumi and canned chickpeas in water, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Heat the fan oven to 200°C. Cut the vegetables for Halloumi chickpea pepper tray into even pieces and toss canned chickpeas in water with a teaspoon of the oil and a pinch of salt in the tin.
steps.tip: Even pieces cook at the same rate, so nothing is burnt while something else is still raw.

steps.instruction: Roast that first tray of canned chickpeas in water while you season halloumi. Pat it dry so the surface browns instead of steaming.
Nestle halloumi and red peppers among the vegetables. Roast until the protein is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
steps.tip: Taste Halloumi chickpea pepper tray before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Rest the tin for a few minutes, taste, and spoon Halloumi chickpea pepper tray into warm bowls with the juices.
